Questions

Is it free?
Yes. No joining fee, no annual fee.
Is it a credit card?
No. It's prepaid, so agents can only spend what you've added.
Which agents work with it?
Any agent that pays online with a card, like Instinct, Muse, Hermes and ChatGPT.
Where can I get it?
Hypercard is an app, coming soon to the App Store and Google Play. It launches in India first. Join the waitlist and we'll tell you when it's live. Questions? Write to hello@hypercard.in.
